Today\'s quiz is done! Next tomorrow.

Wordsense is an English-learning and dictionary application developed by Darkzen Studios. We respect your privacy and aim to keep the app simple, transparent, and privacy-friendly.\n\nThis Privacy Policy explains how Wordsense handles information when you use the application.

Wordsense does not require an account or registration.

We do not ask you to provide personal information such as your:
• Name
• Email address
• Phone number
• Profile information

The current version of Wordsense does not provide user accounts or cloud-based profiles.

Wordsense may store learning-related information locally on your device, including:
• Quiz progress
• Completed quiz status
• Quiz scores
• Selected answers
• Daily quiz information
• App preferences
• Other learning progress required for app functionality

This information is used only to provide features such as quiz progress, results, and continuing an unfinished quiz.

This information is stored locally on your device and is not uploaded to Darkzen Studios.

Wordsense includes a dictionary feature that allows you to search for English words and view information such as meanings, definitions, synonyms, pronunciation, and examples.

When you perform a dictionary search, the requested word may be sent over the internet to a third-party public dictionary API so that the requested dictionary information can be returned.

Wordsense does not intentionally send your name, email address, quiz history, or other locally stored learning information with dictionary searches.

The third-party API provider may receive technical information normally associated with an internet request, such as an IP address or request metadata, according to that provider's own privacy practices.

Wordsense uses local device storage and a local database to provide application functionality.

Locally stored information may include:
• Quiz progress
• Quiz results
• Application preferences
• Other information needed to maintain your learning experience

This information remains on your device unless a feature explicitly states otherwise.

Removing the app, clearing its application data, or using an available reset feature may permanently remove this locally stored information.

An internet connection may be required for certain features, including:
• Dictionary searches that retrieve information from an online dictionary service
• Checking whether a newer version of Wordsense is available
• Opening external links where applicable

The core quiz content may be available locally depending on the version of the application.

Wordsense may check whether a newer version of the application is available.

Some updates may be marked as required when they contain important compatibility, security, content, or functionality changes. In such cases, users may be required to update Wordsense before continuing to use the application.

If Google Play's immediate in-app update flow is used, Google Play manages the update download, installation, and application restart. Google's documentation specifically describes immediate updates as flows intended for updates critical to core functionality where the user must update before continuing.

The current version of Wordsense does not use advertising SDKs or analytics services such as Google Analytics for Firebase.

We do not currently use the app to build advertising profiles or serve personalized advertisements.

If analytics or advertising services are introduced in a future version, this Privacy Policy will be updated before or alongside those changes.

Wordsense only requests Android permissions required for its functionality.

The current application does not intentionally access sensitive information such as:
• Contacts
• Precise location
• Call logs
• SMS messages
• Photos or videos
• Microphone recordings

If new features require additional permissions in the future, they will only be requested when necessary and this Privacy Policy will be updated where appropriate.

Darkzen Studios does not sell users' personal information.

Locally stored quiz and learning information is not intentionally shared with third parties.

Dictionary searches may involve communication with the external dictionary API described above.

Google Play or Android may also process technical information independently when providing Play Store functionality such as application installation and updates. Such processing is governed by Google's own policies.

Because the current version does not require an account, most learning information is stored locally on your device.

You can generally remove locally stored application information by:
• Clearing Wordsense application data through Android settings, or
• Uninstalling Wordsense.

Darkzen Studios cannot normally recover locally stored learning information after it has been removed.

Data processed independently by an external dictionary API or Google Play may be subject to those providers' own retention policies.

Wordsense is a general educational application and is not specifically designed to collect personal information from children.

The current version does not require registration or the submission of personal profile information.

If Wordsense is specifically targeted toward children in a future release, any additional requirements applicable to children's applications will be addressed before that release.

We take reasonable measures to design Wordsense so that unnecessary personal information is not collected.

Network requests should be transmitted using secure connections where supported by the service being accessed.

However, no electronic storage or internet transmission method can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

Wordsense may gain new features over time.

If a future update changes how information is accessed, collected, used, stored, or shared, this Privacy Policy will be updated accordingly.

The date shown at the top of this policy indicates when it was most recently revised.

If you have questions or concerns regarding Wordsense or this Privacy Policy, please contact:

Darkzen Studios
Email: studiodarkzen@gmail.com
Learn English. Practice Daily.\nGrow with Confidence.

Wordsense is a simple and practical English-learning app designed to make everyday learning easier and more enjoyable.\n\nPractice through short quizzes, improve your understanding with clear explanations, and learn from common English mistakes and real-life sentences — one small step at a time.

We believe learning English shouldn't feel complicated or boring.

Our goal is to combine learning, quizzes, stories, and engaging content to help you build better English through consistent practice.

Whether you have five minutes or twenty, every bit of practice counts. 💜
Have feedback, suggestions, or found something we should improve?\nWe\'d love to hear from you.
Wordsense\nLearn a little. Improve every day. 💜
